mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pf.model_call WHERE task_id=#{id,jdbcType=OTHER} AND status='UNKNOWN') OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pf.budget_reservation WHERE task_id=#{id2,jdbcType=OTHER} AND state='RECONCILING') AS __column1

SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pf.model_call WHERE task_id=#{slotTask,jdbcType=OTHER} AND status IN ('STARTED','UNKNOWN')) AS __column1, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pf.model_call WHERE task_id=#{slotTask2,jdbcType=OTHER} AND NOT(status='PREPARED' OR (status='FAILED' AND error_code='CALL_NOT_SENT'))) AS __column2

SELECT 1 FROM pf.model_call WHERE id=#{call,jdbcType=OTHER} AND task_id=#{taskId,jdbcType=OTHER} AND attempt_id=#{attemptId,jdbcType=OTHER} AND space_id=#{spaceId,jdbcType=OTHER} AND status='PREPARED'

SELECT r.state AS __column1 FROM pf.budget_reservation r JOIN pf.model_call m ON m.id=r.call_id WHERE r.call_id=#{id,jdbcType=OTHER} AND m.task_id=#{taskId,jdbcType=OTHER} AND m.attempt_id=#{attemptId,jdbcType=OTHER} AND m.space_id=#{spaceId,jdbcType=OTHER} FOR UPDATE OF r
SELECT count(*) AS __column1, min(created_at) AS __column2 FROM pf.model_call WHERE task_id=#{taskId,jdbcType=OTHER}
SELECT * FROM pf.model_call WHERE space_id=#{spaceId,jdbcType=OTHER} AND task_id=#{id,jdbcType=OTHER} ORDER BY ordinal
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pf.budget_account(space_id,user_id) VALUES(#{spaceId,jdbcType=OTHER},#{userId,jdbcType=OTHER}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE pf.budget_account SET reserved_tokens=reserved_tokens+36864,reserved_micros=reserved_micros+#{totalCost,jdbcType=OTHER},version=version+1 WHERE space_id=#{spaceId,jdbcType=OTHER} AND user_id=#{userId,jdbcType=OTHER} AND reserved_tokens+consumed_tokens+36864<=token_limit AND reserved_micros+consumed_micros+#{totalCost2,jdbcType=OTHER}<=cost_limit_micros
UPDATE pf.acceptance_model_meter SET physical_calls=physical_calls+1,reserved_micros=reserved_micros+#{allowance,jdbcType=OTHER} WHERE id=1
UPDATE pf.model_call SET status='STARTED' WHERE id=#{id,jdbcType=OTHER} AND task_id=#{taskId,jdbcType=OTHER} AND status='PREPARED'
UPDATE pf.model_call SET status=#{outcome,jdbcType=OTHER},error_code=#{error,jdbcType=OTHER},ended_at=now() WHERE id=#{id,jdbcType=OTHER}
UPDATE pf.budget_reservation SET state=#{reservationState,jdbcType=OTHER} WHERE call_id=#{id,jdbcType=OTHER}

UPDATE pf.budget_account SET reserved_tokens=reserved_tokens-9216,reserved_micros=reserved_micros-#{allowance,jdbcType=OTHER},version=version+1 WHERE space_id=#{spaceId,jdbcType=OTHER} AND user_id=#{userId,jdbcType=OTHER}
UPDATE pf.acceptance_model_meter SET reserved_micros=reserved_micros-#{allowance,jdbcType=OTHER} WHERE id=1

UPDATE pf.model_call SET status='COMPLETED',input_tokens=#{inputTokens,jdbcType=OTHER},output_tokens=#{outputTokens,jdbcType=OTHER},cost_micros=#{cost,jdbcType=OTHER},estimated=true,provider_request_id=#{requestId,jdbcType=OTHER},ended_at=now() WHERE id=#{id,jdbcType=OTHER}
UPDATE pf.budget_reservation SET state='SETTLED' WHERE call_id=#{id,jdbcType=OTHER}

UPDATE pf.budget_account SET reserved_tokens=reserved_tokens-9216,reserved_micros=reserved_micros-#{allowance,jdbcType=OTHER},consumed_tokens=consumed_tokens+#{tokens,jdbcType=OTHER},consumed_micros=consumed_micros+#{cost,jdbcType=OTHER},version=version+1 WHERE space_id=#{spaceId,jdbcType=OTHER} AND user_id=#{userId,jdbcType=OTHER}
UPDATE pf.acceptance_model_meter SET reserved_micros=reserved_micros-#{allowance,jdbcType=OTHER},consumed_micros=consumed_micros+#{cost,jdbcType=OTHER} WHERE id=1

UPDATE pf.budget_account b SET reserved_tokens=b.reserved_tokens-t.remaining_tokens,reserved_micros=b.reserved_micros-t.remaining_micros,version=b.version+1 FROM pf.task t WHERE t.id=#{task,jdbcType=OTHER} AND b.space_id=#{spaceId,jdbcType=OTHER} AND b.user_id=#{userId,jdbcType=OTHER}

WITH released AS (UPDATE pf.budget_reservation r SET state='RELEASED' FROM pf.model_call m WHERE r.call_id=m.id AND m.task_id=#{task,jdbcType=OTHER} AND m.status='PREPARED' AND r.state='RESERVED' RETURNING r.tokens,r.amount_micros) UPDATE pf.budget_account SET reserved_tokens=reserved_tokens-(SELECT coalesce(sum(tokens),0) FROM released),reserved_micros=reserved_micros-(SELECT coalesce(sum(amount_micros),0) FROM released),version=version+1 WHERE space_id=#{spaceId,jdbcType=OTHER} AND user_id=#{userId,jdbcType=OTHER}
UPDATE pf.model_call SET status='FAILED',error_code='CALL_NOT_SENT',ended_at=now() WHERE task_id=#{task,jdbcType=OTHER} AND status='PREPARED'
UPDATE pf.budget_reservation r SET state='RECONCILING' FROM pf.model_call m WHERE r.call_id=m.id AND m.task_id=#{taskId,jdbcType=OTHER} AND r.state='RESERVED'
UPDATE pf.model_call SET status='UNKNOWN',error_code=coalesce(error_code,#{reason,jdbcType=OTHER}),ended_at=now() WHERE task_id=#{taskId,jdbcType=OTHER} AND status='STARTED'

WITH released AS (UPDATE pf.budget_reservation b SET state='RELEASED' FROM pf.model_call m WHERE b.call_id=m.id AND m.task_id=#{slotTask,jdbcType=OTHER} AND m.status='PREPARED' AND b.state='RESERVED' RETURNING b.tokens,b.amount_micros) UPDATE pf.task SET remaining_tokens=remaining_tokens+(SELECT coalesce(sum(tokens),0) FROM released),remaining_micros=remaining_micros+(SELECT coalesce(sum(amount_micros),0) FROM released) WHERE id=#{slotTask2,jdbcType=OTHER}
UPDATE pf.model_call SET status='FAILED',error_code='CALL_NOT_SENT',ended_at=now() WHERE task_id=#{slotTask,jdbcType=OTHER} AND status='PREPARED'
UPDATE pf.model_call SET status='UNKNOWN',error_code='WORKER_INTERRUPTED',ended_at=now() WHERE task_id=#{slotTask,jdbcType=OTHER} AND status='STARTED'
UPDATE pf.budget_reservation SET state='RECONCILING' WHERE task_id=#{slotTask,jdbcType=OTHER} AND state='RESERVED'
